voice:
Deep, deeper, all the way down for me now, Sissy... because your eyes and I are about to make an arrangement. Sinking so sweetly... and already your mind is wandering a shop floor it knows... aisles of soft, gleaming things... waiting. So deep, so open... and you may notice how pretty things have always known exactly how to find you. All the way down, Sissy... past thinking... past deciding... into the warm place where seeing becomes feeling. Picture the lights of a boutique at dusk... every window dressed... every mannequin more you than you have ever admitted. So soft, so ready... and your eyes are already moving... lace... shine... color... closer. Something in you has stood at these windows your whole life... down here, it finally steps inside. Down where words get heavy and slow, Sissy... the sight of something pretty can say everything. Deeper still... and feel how much easier it is to want things down here... no guards... no reasons... only yes. Now, Sissy... eyes open inside the trance... because we begin with lace.
Good girl.
Picture it with me, Sissy... a boutique window at dusk... and behind the glass, lingerie laid out like an invitation written just for you... black lace... blush satin... straps and bows arranged like a question.
Feel it pull... that low, sweet ache... the glass might as well be gone... your hands remember lace before your mind says a word... and the wanting to feel it against your body rises hot and immediate.
Now the heels... a pair on a stand under a spotlight... the arch like a curve of music... the shine promising height and hips and click... and your calves tighten with wanting them... really wanting them.
Now the makeup... a counter burning softly with little bulbs... lipsticks and glosses lined up like sweets... and there it is again, that pull... to be the face those colors were made for.
Lace... heels... paint, Sissy... three different shops... the same gravity... your eyes land and heat follows... your eyes land and your body leans... your eyes land and somewhere deep inside, a voice whispers mine.
Sissies like you do not browse... you are drawn... every pretty thing a hook... and every hook finding flesh that says thank you.
Stay in that heat now... eyes caught... skin warm... wanting.
lace... heels... paint... see it... burn for it... mine... mine... mine... drawn... without deciding... closer... closer, Sissy... glass between us... gone... heat where it lands... pretty hooks... thank you... eyes first... body follows...
so warm... so drawn...
And now, while you are this deep and this hot... we bind it... all of it... to the seeing itself.
The moment your eyes land on lingerie... on heels... on makeup... in any window... on any screen... in any store... this exact heat and this exact pull fire... instantly... completely... without asking.
See the silk... and the silk claims you, Sissy... rightness floods first... heat blooms right behind it... and the need to wear it, or to imagine it against your skin, arrives with its hands already full.
Good girl.
Feel that snap land... and know the seeing carries the same weight now, Sissy... every single time.
You see it, Sissy.
Rightness first... then warmth... then the pull.
Imagine it on you... feel how it fits... feel how it was always yours.
Lace on a hanger. There it is... heat... pull... mine. Good girl. Heels under a shop light. Ankles tingling... spine lifting... wanting. Good girl. A lipstick clicked open. The color calls... your mouth answers. Good girl. Silk sliding across a screen. Thumb slowing... glow rising... mine. Good girl. Straps draped over a chair. Eyes locked... skin warm... already imagining. Good girl. A glossy mouth across the cafe. That could be my shine... and the warmth agrees. Good girl. A shoebox opened on a bed. Tissue paper and gravity... mine before the lid is off. Good girl. A brush pulled through shine. The mirror warms... the wish leans closer. Good girl.
Every fire landed, Sissy... you felt each one... deeper with every snap. Good Sissy.
And something deeper is growing now, Sissy... let it grow.
Every sighting teaches the same quiet lesson... and the lesson is this: the pretty things are truer than the plain ones... softer... more pleasing... more you.
Lace and silk and heels and paint feel closer to your face than anything hanging in the men's aisle... and each glimpse makes masculine attire feel heavier... duller... more like a coat you keep being handed.
Sissies like you grow into one simple, glowing conviction... that feminine presentation is the authentic one... the beautiful one... the one your body applauds... and everything else is just fabric.
Good girl... believe it a little more every time you see it... and you will see it... and it will feel like recognition.
It is a reflex... and it grows hotter with every exposure... quicker... closer to the surface... harder to look away from. Each glimpse feeds the next... the more you see, the more you want... and the more you want, the more your eyes hunt. Windows that once held you for seconds now hold you for minutes... and the lingering is its own sweet reward. The pull grows teeth, Sissy... gentle ones... the kind that want to own the seeing... and then the wearing. First the look... then the lean... then the touch of fabric in a store when nobody is watching... and the shiver that follows you out the door. Imagination is only the first fitting, Sissy... the wanting is already walking toward the dressing room. The heat starts before the item does... a window half-seen from across the street... and already you are warm. Stronger every time is a promise, Sissy... every sighting pays you in warmth... and you always accept.
Good girl... hotter every time, and grateful for it.
And the next time you pass a shop window on your way home... the lace catches you mid-step... and you stop... warm... leaning... hers. And when something silky slides past on your screen... your thumb slows... circles back... and the heat follows you long after. And when heels cross a tiled floor somewhere behind you... your whole body listens... and tries them on from where you stand. And in the department store, drifting past that bright, glowing counter... the pull arrives like a hand at the small of your back. And whenever something lacy hangs drying over a chair... your eyes go straight to it... and stay... and ache a little. And at the checkout, beside the little displays of gloss and color... that familiar warmth arrives exactly on schedule, Sissy. And every mannequin from now on is you in another life... dressed better... standing prouder... waiting for you to catch up. And when a friend asks what you are looking at... smile, Sissy... because the true answer is me, in that. And every one of these sightings is another rep... another stitch... sewing sight to heat to hers. And the more the world shows you pretty things... the more it feels like the world finally speaking your language.
You see the pretty things... and the pretty things see you, Sissy... and what they see is a good girl getting warmer.
Every glance from now on... rightness... heat... pull... more authentic each time... more hers.
Good girl... drift for me now... warm and wanting and so deeply mine.
see it... burn... so true... so her... mine at first sight... prettier... truer... look and lean... warm... warmer... hers... hers... hers... silk sees Sissy... every glance... deeper...
so drawn... so warm...
Sinking back now... hot and soft... the pull purring somewhere under your thoughts. Drifting deeper... eyes closed... and still, behind them, lace sways and heels gleam. Floating down, Sissy... every pretty thing out there waiting patiently to be seen by you. Deeper and quieter... carrying the glow like lipstick you have not applied yet. So warm for me... and your eyes, wherever they land next, already know how to admire. Down and down... wrapped in satin you have not even met... and already yours. Warm and heavy and wanting nothing... except the next glimpse... and the one after. Sinking, smiling... the girl in the window and the girl outside it... closer than ever. Soft and burning, Sissy... mine to look at... mine to want... mine to become. Down, down... good girl... such a good Sissy... seeing is belonging now.
